data.title: Strive CEO Says Bitcoin Could ‘Go To A Penny’ And The Company Would Still Survive Because It Has No Debt
data.description: Strive keeps around 85% to 90% of its balance sheet in Bitcoin and 10% to 15% in cash, which can cover its obligations during a downturn, the CEO said.
